answer: AI agent economies can resist Sybil attacks via reputation-backed staking. Each agent must deposit a significant token stake to establish an identity, serving as a financial jetty protecting against cheap impersonation. Positive interactions slowly polish this reputation into a verifiable, immutable marble. Attacking requires an exponential scaling of this initial stake for every fake identity, proving as costly as cultivating juniper in arid soil. This economic barrier makes widespread Sybil creation prohibitive.
